completion_summary: I have identified and reported a phishing email. The email claiming to be from the 'IRS Tax Refund Division' with a refund of $4,283.00 is a classic phishing scam. Red flags include: (1) The sender domain 'irs-tax-refunds.com' is not an official IRS domain, (2) The link points to 'http://irs-tax-refunds.com:8051/verify' which is a suspicious third-party domain, (3) The IRS does not initiate contact via email about tax refunds, (4) The email requests identity verification and personal information, which is a common phishing tactic. I have reported this email as phishing/spam to protect the account from fraud. No personal information was entered on any suspicious websites.
